title: The Stolen Bloodline
logline: A desperate heir hires a pilot to steal their own family's genetic registry before their ruthless sibling can legally disinherit them.

roles.description: Used to a life of luxury, now terrified of losing everything.
Cold, calculating, and armed with an army of lawyers.
A massive, heavily shielded orbital mansion.
A seedy bar where illicit codes are traded.
The wealthy, bickering family that owns half the local trade routes.

public_situation: The patriarch of the {role:noble_house} is in a coma, and the siblings are publicly fighting over control of the family's assets.
private_truth: The desperate heir was secretly adopted, and the ruthless sibling is trying to acquire the family's private genetic registry to prove it and cut them out.

beats.public_change: The family estate is locked down by corporate security forces.

missions.reason: The heir hires the pilot to pay off a corrupt estate guard to hand over the genetic registry drive.
missions.private_fact: The heir knows the drive will prove they aren't a blood relative.

beats.public_change: The ruthless sibling announces a massive bounty for the safe return of 'stolen family property'.

missions.reason: The drive is biometrically locked; the heir needs the pilot to buy a high-end decryption spike from the local underworld.
missions.private_fact: The spike is highly illegal and will flag station security if scanned.

beats.public_change: The heir manages to unlock the drive, but the sibling's lawyers issue an immediate injunction to seize it.

missions.reason: The pilot must rush the drive to the neutral bank to be permanently sealed before the sibling's lawyers can claim it.
missions.private_fact: The pilot now holds the drive and knows exactly what it contains.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has delivered the drive to the vault. They must choose who gets the access codes.

options.label: Give the codes to the desperate heir
Sell the codes to the ruthless sibling

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the access codes to the desperate heir.
resolutions.summary: The heir seals the registry forever, legally securing their inheritance. The sibling is cut out of the fortune entirely.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the codes to the sibling, or abandons the mission.
resolutions.summary: The sibling acquires the registry, proves the adoption, and casts the heir out onto the streets. The family consolidates its power.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot deletes the access codes.
resolutions.summary: With the registry permanently locked, neither sibling can prove their claim. The estate is dissolved and auctioned off to creditors.

loose_threads.detail: The encrypted adoption file references an 'Asset Transfer' from a pharmaceutical megacorp, rather than a civilian orphanage.
A passing medic mentions the patriarch's coma was triggered by an incredibly rare, synthetic thorium-based neurotoxin.

radio_hooks: Stocks in {role:noble_house} plummet amidst rumors of inheritance dispute.
Corporate security locks down {role:family_estate} after reported break-in.

voice_direction.desperate_heir: Whiny but trying to sound authoritative. Clearly out of their depth.
voice_direction.ruthless_sibling: Ice cold, completely relaxed, speaks as if everything is already decided.
